facts.value: Division in the Church of Scotland over spiritual jurisdiction, from which the Free Church of Scotland dated its existence.

citations.excerpt: In one sense the Free Church of Scotland dated its existence from the Disruption of 1843
The fact that the Church, as led first by John Knox and afterwards by Andrew Melville, claimed an inherent right to exercise a spiritual jurisdiction is notorious.
